file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This error is thrown in src/ingest/parser.ts indicating a row shape mismatch during file upload parsing. Given the user reports consistent errors on row 1 while the files appear structurally consistent, the issue likely lies in the parsing or validation logic of the header or first row fields in parser.ts, especially since the only external change is the source export tool. Addressing this in the parser.ts file is appropriate.
